plugins.description: Lean 4 language server with automatic Lake project-root detection (works even when the session root is above the project), elan toolchain resolution, and multi-project routing. Bundles the lean-goal CLI for proof-goal state, sorry inventory, and fast diagnostics — plus a skill teaching the interactive proving workflow.
